description.value: Walmart Supercenter Store 1077 is a large-format retail location in Campbell River serving Vancouver Island's Discovery Coast. As a Supercenter, it carries a full grocery department alongside general merchandise including electronics, clothing, and baby products. For a touring cyclist, it represents one of the most comprehensive resupply stops on this stretch of the island.
